### News
**06/06/26**     Our paper, [_Visual Decoding Operators_](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.02220), got conditionally accepted at [IEEE VIS 2026](https://ieeevis.org/year/2026/welcome/)! Time to work on those feedback 🔧

**05/27/26**     I successfully defended my dissertation, _Computational Models of Visualization Perception_. 

**04/03/26**     I am co-organizing the [VisXVision workshop](https://ieeevis.org/year/2026/info/program/workshops/#vis-x-vision) with [Arran Zeyu Wang](https://www.linkedin.com/in/arranwang/), which got approved to be an official workshop at VIS'26.

I am a final-year Ph.D. candidate at [Northwestern University](https://www.northwestern/edu/), fortunate to be advised by Professor [Matthew Kay](https://www.mjskay.com/) at [Mu Collective](https://mucollective.northwestern.edu/).

Before joining Northwestern, I was a student at [William & Mary](https://www.wm.edu/), where I majored in Computer Science and Economics.

## Research

My research focuses on developing theoretical frameworks and empirical tools to better understand how people reason about and interact with abstract visual information. I had also worked on questions that involve more economics and fairness concerns previously.
